concerns: The reading for {水|みず}{茶屋|ぢゃや} (18) and {引|ひき}{手|て}{茶屋|ぢゃや} (20, 21) uses ぢゃや for 茶屋. While this is a valid rendaku pronunciation, the primary entry for 茶屋 (1) is ちゃや. The dictionary entry itself is for {茶屋|ちゃや} (ちゃや), suggesting that ちゃや is the standard reading. The use of ぢゃや in these compounds, while phonetically plausible, might be considered an inconsistency if the dictionary aims for the most common or base reading in its primary entry.
